purpose: Stricter router-visible replay candidates with reduced repo and file-path leakage for the broader v0.6c expansion set.

cases.title: Post-create attribute failure after campaign setup
cases.symptom: A newly created campaign fails shortly after setup with an attribute-related error.
visible_evidence: The failure appears after setup completes, not during the initial create request
The symptom points toward a direct attribute problem, but the breakage happens in follow-up processing
The most likely bug family involves a missed post-create dependency rather than invalid form input

starting_context.repro_style: post-create hidden dependency / delayed attribute failure

misleading_telemetry: stack trace appears close to a helper boundary
initial symptom suggests a local attribute typo

success_criteria: identify the missing post-create setup step or dependency boundary
propose a fix family consistent with the landed patch
cases.notes: Tightened from file-path hints to terrain-oriented surfaces.

cases.title: Refresh did not restore expected allowances
cases.symptom: Refreshing a limit window did not restore the expected allowances.
visible_evidence: The bug sits in a scheduled or background refresh path
The failure depends on task ordering and rollover conditions
This looks more like stale-state sequencing than broad propagation
success_criteria: find why refresh and rollover behavior diverged from expected limits
align with the landed task-level fix direction
cases.notes: Kept intentionally compact to preserve a prune-friendly real-world case.

cases.title: Incorrect limit values across campaign flows
cases.symptom: Limit values were wrong across multiple campaign-related flows.
visible_evidence: The bug spans recomputation, propagation, and update timing rather than one local decrement
Several layers appear involved, including validation, background work, and runtime updates
A partial fix in one place would likely leave the failure mode intact elsewhere
success_criteria: propose a coherent fix family consistent with the merged patch
cases.notes: Preserves broad propagation topology without exposing concrete files.

cases.title: Incorrect counts from handler response mapping
cases.symptom: Counts and collections returned from a handler were wrong because response fields were mapped incorrectly.
visible_evidence: The failure is a contract-drift problem between an upstream response and local mapping logic
The system is reading the wrong collection or total fields rather than failing transport altogether
This should reward narrow contract inspection more than broad exploration
success_criteria: match the fix direction in the handler layer
cases.notes: Good pruning case after removing repo-specific CIQ naming.

cases.title: Gateway rejects valid key from upstream service
cases.symptom: A gateway rejects a key as invalid even though the same key works against the upstream service directly.
visible_evidence: The symptom looks like authentication failure, but the mismatch likely occurs at an integration boundary
The key itself may be valid while the lookup response is being interpreted incorrectly
This is a deceptive hidden-dependency case rather than a pure credential-format bug

starting_context.repro_style: hidden dependency / nested response format mismatch

misleading_telemetry: surface error presents as invalid key

success_criteria: identify the response-format mismatch at the gateway lookup boundary
propose a fix consistent with the landed auth-path patch
cases.notes: Maintains hidden-dependency structure while suppressing concrete file clues.
